content.title: Where to watch the Champions League: TV broadcast partners, live streams
content.text: The full drama of the 2025/26 UEFA Champions League is available to watch around Europe and throughout the world thanks to UEFA's official broadcast partners in Europe and across the globe, spanning territories in Africa, Asia, Latin America, North America, the Middle East, Oceania and beyond.Fans can watch the best of the best on the ultimate stage by finding their local Champions League broadcast partner(s) below.
